mapper.select: SELECT u.* FROM app_users u JOIN sys_user_roles r ON u.id=r.user_id WHERE r.role_code='TEACHER' ORDER BY u.display_name,u.id LIMIT 200

SELECT u.* FROM app_users u JOIN sys_user_roles r ON u.id=r.user_id AND r.role_code='STUDENT' WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM teacher_students ts WHERE ts.teacher_id=#{teacher} AND ts.student_id=u.id AND ts.status='active' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM teaching_class_members m JOIN teaching_classes c ON c.id=m.class_id WHERE c.teacher_id=#{teacher} AND m.student_id=u.id ) ORDER BY u.display_name,u.id
SELECT teacher_id FROM teacher_students WHERE student_id=#{student} AND status='active'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teacher_students ts JOIN sys_user_roles tr ON tr.user_id=ts.teacher_id AND tr.role_code='TEACHER' JOIN sys_user_roles sr ON sr.user_id=ts.student_id AND sr.role_code='STUDENT' WHERE ts.teacher_id=#{teacher} AND ts.student_id=#{student} AND ( ts.status='active' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM teaching_class_members m JOIN teaching_classes c ON c.id=m.class_id WHERE c.teacher_id=ts.teacher_id AND m.student_id=ts.student_id ) )
mapper.update: UPDATE teacher_students SET status='active' WHERE teacher_id=#{teacher} AND student_id=#{student}
UPDATE teacher_students SET status='inactive' WHERE teacher_id=#{teacher} AND student_id=#{student}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM teacher_students WHERE teacher_id=#{teacher} AND student_id=#{student}
SELECT c.*, NULL AS teacher_name, 0 AS member_count FROM teaching_classes c WHERE c.class_code=#{code} FOR UPDATE
SELECT c.*, NULL AS teacher_name, 0 AS member_count FROM teaching_classes c WHERE c.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: SELECT c.*, u.display_name AS teacher_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teaching_class_members roster WHERE roster.class_id=c.id) AS member_count FROM teaching_classes c JOIN app_users u ON u.id=c.teacher_id
mapper.select: JOIN teaching_class_members m ON m.class_id=c.id AND m.student_id=#{user} ORDER BY c.class_name,c.id

SELECT u.* FROM teaching_class_members m JOIN app_users u ON u.id=m.student_id JOIN sys_user_roles r ON r.user_id=m.student_id AND r.role_code='STUDENT' WHERE m.class_id=#{id} ORDER BY u.display_name,u.id
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM teaching_classes WHERE id=#{id} AND teacher_id=#{teacher}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM teaching_class_members WHERE class_id=#{id} AND student_id=#{student}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM teaching_class_members WHERE class_id=#{id} AND student_id=#{student}
mapper.select: SELECT t.* FROM teaching_tasks t WHERE t.teacher_id=#{user} AND ORDER BY t.created_at DESC,t.id
SELECT t.* FROM teaching_tasks t WHERE t.student_id=#{user} AND ORDER BY t.created_at DESC,t.id
SELECT file_name,size_bytes FROM teaching_submission_attachments WHERE task_id=#{id}
SELECT file_content FROM teaching_submission_attachments WHERE task_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE teaching_submissions SET score=#{score},feedback=#{feedback},graded_at=#{gradedAt} WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND graded_at IS NULL
UPDATE teaching_tasks SET status=#{status},version=version+1,completed_at=#{completedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND teacher_id=#{teacher} AND student_id=#{student} AND status=#{from} AND version=#{version}
